title: There is, I need, and questions
explanation: When you hunt for an apartment, you describe rooms with There is / There are, you say I need or I want, and you ask present simple questions.

sections.heading: There is / There are
sections.text: There is a bedroom. There is a kitchen. There are two windows. Use is for one thing and are for more than one.

sections.heading: I need / I want
sections.text: I need an apartment downtown. I want a viewing on Saturday. Need is stronger than want.

sections.heading: Present simple questions
sections.text: Is there a kitchen? What is the rent? Can I have a viewing? Keep questions short.

try_it: Call a landlord and say: I need a bedroom. Is there a kitchen? What is the rent?
